title: eritrichium rupestre subvar. spathulatum
intro: Eritrichium rupestre subvar. spathulatum, commonly known as a type of alpine forget-me-not, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the borage family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Eritrichium rupestre subvar. spathulatum include its ability to soothe skin irritations, calm digestive issues, and support respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
